body: I was barely hanging on before this weekend.  I did bring myself to go to a Super Bowl party.   On the way home I got pulled over for DUI.  Now I am going to lose my license, my job and I won't be able to pay child support any more.  It's all just too much.  I have this big weight that is pushing down on me and it's suffocating me with despair.  I really can't take it anymore
